blocking_focus: Complete the candidate-bound Tester MCP state matrix.

preservation_constraints.requirement: Keep frozen technical baseline `native_godot_project` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

Keep frozen technical baseline `host_godot_boot` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

acceptance_requirements: Keep the frozen R01 requirement for three traversable maps and both chapter boundaries, and the full R02 movement and camera contract. This increment does not complete either requirement.
Preserve MAP01 bridge traversal, directly launchable MAP02 traversal, Shift sprint, Space jump, mouse look, shoulder switching, cursor recapture, native Godot project validity, and host boot.
Judge the new behavior through ordinary input, candidate-bound state and shipped-camera frames. Source inspection alone is supporting evidence.
deferred_items: MAP02 entry after all Chapter 1 prerequisites, MAP03, and the complete two-boundary journey remain mandatory; the boundary must not open early to make MAP02 appear reachable.
Alt/B dodge and roll, automatic step traversal, locomotion poses, and equipment presentation remain mandatory R02 work.
The full milestone teaching, progression, save, and reload sequence remains open.
implied_completion: A locked chapter boundary gives the player a reachable interaction and names the missing objectives without allowing premature travel.
A camera repair is assessed at the original wall contact and camera orientation on both shoulders, with the ranger and onward route readable.
mandatory_objectives: Treat the pinned missing-maps issue through the shipped MAP01 boundary and scene binding, rather than another separately launchable map.
Repair the reproducible south-wall camera crop as one bounded R02 advance.
Reproduce the remaining R02 action failures and report them separately; preserve the frozen gap until the full contract passes.
task_specification.objective: Make the first chapter boundary legible in the shipped MAP01 route and restore player framing at its south wall, while preserving the existing movement and map traversal.

diagnosis.root_cause: The previous map work produced a traversable MAP02 scene but did not bind a chapter boundary into the shipped MAP01 journey. The R02 controller still lacks several declared actions, while the existing camera collision and framing path removes the ranger from view at the MAP01 south wall.

stop_conditions: If the candidate has no trustworthy Chapter 1 prerequisite state, keep the boundary locked and report MAP02 entry as unfinished; do not add an unconditional shortcut.
Do not claim m01-maps-absent, m01-r02-missing-actions, the R02 gap, or milestone_01_review closed from this bounded increment.
If candidate-bound ordinary-input frames or state for the original wall reproduction are unavailable, report camera verification as insufficient evidence.

strategy.rationale: The prior strategy added an isolated MAP02 and sprint but left the shipped route disconnected. This iteration examines the main-scene boundary and tests the camera at the original wall contact before choosing a repair; it does not repeat standalone map construction or visual transform tuning.

code: Inspect the resulting main-scene binding, chapter-prerequisite handling, input bindings, and camera changes; confirm no unconditional MAP02 access or regression to the existing controls.
Run the native Godot project and host boot checks.
runtime: Host/Tester recapture: from the shipped main scene, traverse to the first boundary and interact before prerequisites are met; record position, current map, interaction result, and unmet-goal feedback.
Host/Tester recapture: repeat the original south-wall contact on both shoulders, then retreat; pair physical Tab and movement input with camera/player state and frames.

Recheck MAP01 bridge and jump, MAP02 direct-launch traversal, Shift sprint, mouse look, Escape release, and click recapture. Run the frozen R02 and milestone checks and report pass, fail, and unmeasured conditions separately.
visual: Compare shipped-camera frames at boundary approach and locked interaction, plus south-wall contact and retreat on both shoulders.
Check any new visible boundary resource at player scale for PRD style, material quality, readable destination and unmet-goal feedback, and actual runtime binding.

done_when: Starting from the shipped main scene, ordinary movement reaches an identifiable first chapter boundary; interacting while Chapter 1 prerequisites are unmet gives a readable list of missing goals, leaves the player safely in MAP01, and does not load MAP02.

At the original MAP01 south-wall contact with the camera facing the original route direction, the ranger remains visibly framed in shipped-camera views on both shoulders; moving away restores normal follow behavior without breaking mouse look or Tab switching.
tasks.instructions: Use frozen PRD §§3.1, 5.1, 5.1.1, 5.2 and R01/R02. Inspect the existing MAP01 route, the isolated MAP02 scene, and the shipped main-scene assembly.
